questions.stem_text:
When a swimmer leaves cold water on a warm, breezy day, he experiences a cooling effect.
Why?

options.A: The cold water causes a decrease in the swimmer's metabolic rate.
options.B: The swimmer feels cold due to the temperature difference.
options.C: Evaporation of water from the swimmer's skin cools the body down.
options.D: The swimmer feels cold due to the wind chill factor.
options.E: The swimmer's body is adapting to the water temperature after exiting.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The cold water causes a decrease in the swimmer's metabolic rate.
